name: insurerA_terms
_comment: Insurer A's commercial terms. Competing insurers work on one channel while keeping pricing, reserving assumptions and reinsurance arrangements out of each other's sight. Without this the consortium is commercially impossible: no insurer will settle on a shared ledger that hands a competitor its book.

name: insurerB_terms
_comment: The same, for Insurer B. Scenario S11 attempts a cross-read and is refused.

name: enrolment_pii
_comment: The mapping from a subject commitment back to a real person. Only the enrolling aggregator and the enrolling insurer hold it, and neither holds the PRF key that produced the commitment -- that is split across custodians in different classes. Two separate secrets, two separate custodians: neither party alone can turn a ledger entry into a person.

name: clinical_refs
_comment: Content hashes and access envelopes for documents in the off-chain vault. The documents themselves are never here. Field verifiers are deliberately absent from this collection: they attest that an admission happened and never see clinical data.
